ready.description: Number of agents with Ready status.

checks.description: What the controller that answered checked for this answer: its connection to NATS and to the KV store.

error.description: Why the check failed. Absent when it is ok.

name.description: What was checked, such as nats.

consumers.description: Total number of JetStream consumers: the sum of the consumers of each stream.

dlq.description: Number of jobs in the dead letter queue.

keys.description: Number of keys in the bucket.

registry.description: All registered components with health details, each with its sub-components.

address.description: Listen address of a sub-component, such as :8080.

components.description: The sub-components of the component, such as its api and its metrics server, sorted by name.

type.description: Component type (agent, controller, nats), or the name of a sub-component, such as api.

url.description: Where a person opens a sub-component, from its url config key.

version.description: Build version of the component's binary.

consumers.description: Number of consumers on the stream.

messages.description: Number of messages in the stream.

200.description: The status of each component. A component that is not healthy makes the overall status degraded; the request still succeeds.

error.description: A description of the error that occurred.

reason.description: Why the request failed, as a word that a program can branch on. The HTTP status is the class of the problem; the reason is the cause, and the error is the message for a person, which can change between releases. invalid_request: the request breaks a rule, such as a missing field (400). unauthorized: no token, or a token that is not valid (401). forbidden: the token does not have the permission (403). not_found: the host or osapi does not have what the request names (404). not_managed: the item is there, but osapi did not deploy it, so osapi does not change it (409). not_installed: the host does not have a program that the request needs (409). conflict: the state of the item blocks the request, such as a create of one that exists (409). unavailable: a part that osapi depends on is down, such as NATS (503). server_error: the controller failed; its log has the cause (500).
